store.summary: Four-voice drone synthesizer with deep modulation and effects
store.description:
Dronage 0 is a drone workstation for the CardputerZero.

Four macro oscillator voices with 35 synthesis engines each, eight LFOs, a modulation matrix, a five-track modulation sequencer, a macro control, euclidean gates, delay, reverb, tape dirt and a compressor. Eight scenes per project, undo and redo, microtonal scales, twenty colour themes, WAV recording, and a page of full-screen visualizers.

Keys: 4 to 8 pick a screen, F Z X C move the cursor, K N and M B change a value, Q W E R start and stop the four voices, H shows the key list, Esc opens the menu. Projects are kept in ~/Dronage.
